queries.search_text: site:gov.pl OR site:europa.eu Poland SMEs 2025 regulatory compliance cybersecurity product packaging sustainability obligations
queries.source_title: Map of Cybersecurity SMEs in Poland: Diagnosis, Needs, Recommendation I 2025
queries.proposition: An official 2025 sector report describes expanding EU cyber obligations, including supply-chain security, incident reporting, product-lifecycle vulnerability management, and likely demand for audits, testing, consulting, and certification among Polish SMEs and suppliers to regulated entities.
queries.status: Official problem-and-mechanism evidence; it does not establish willingness to pay for any proposed offer.
queries.contradiction: The report frames regulation as market opportunity, but scope, Polish transposition, enforcement timing, customer readiness, and accessible budgets vary and may be reduced by later simplification or free public tools.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Show one-page fixed-scope offers to 15 named operators in each niche and seek three paid deposits contingent on a documented applicability screen.

queries.search_text: site:gov.pl OR site:stat.gov.pl Poland 2025 aging population long-term care caregivers home care municipalities report
queries.source_title: Gminy nie są gotowe na starzenie się społeczeństwa. NIK wskazuje luki w opiece nad seniorami
queries.proposition: Poland's Supreme Audit Office reports weak identification of at-risk seniors, imprecise care-service records, missing quality monitoring, funding interruptions, specialist shortages, and absence of basic home care in some rural and mixed municipalities.
queries.status: Recent official operational-gap evidence; the audit does not prove that municipalities or families will buy the proposed products.
queries.contradiction: The detailed audit covered 19 municipalities, so national prevalence and local procurement urgency remain uncertain; some gaps may require staffing or policy rather than software.
queries.cheapest_resolving_test: Interview ten municipal social-care directors and five contracted providers using the audit findings, then request two paid, eight-week pilots with predefined administrative-hours or missed-visit outcomes.

concepts.title: Ransomware Continuity Kit for Funeral Homes
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Sell small funeral operators an offline-first continuity pack that preserves dispatch, family contacts, statutory documents, and supplier coordination when their ordinary systems are unavailable.
concepts.customer: Independent Polish funeral homes and crematoria
concepts.loss_event: A cyber incident or system outage halts time-sensitive body transport, ceremony scheduling, documentation, or family communication.
concepts.authority_holder: Funeral-home owner and the relevant data controller
concepts.distributor: Funeral-management software vendors, trade associations, and specialist insurers
concepts.first_paid_event: Fixed-fee continuity assessment plus encrypted offline kit and tabletop drill
concepts.acquisition_route: Partner referrals from funeral software, accounting, and insurance providers rather than public-facing content
concepts.compounding_asset: An anonymized library of outage scenarios, recovery checklists, and integration templates for funeral workflows
hypotheses: Funeral operators experience enough digital dependency to value a tested offline workflow.
Existing vendors do not already bundle adequate continuity support.
Budget size and willingness to pay are unknown.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not use bereavement data for marketing or imply regulatory certification that has not been granted.

concepts.title: Small Water Utility Supplier-Security Desk
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Provide small water and wastewater operators with a managed evidence desk for vendor inventories, access reviews, incident contacts, and board-ready remediation tracking.
concepts.customer: Municipal water and wastewater companies with lean IT teams
concepts.loss_event: An unmanaged supplier account or unsupported device causes service disruption, reportable exposure, or failed oversight review.
concepts.payer: Utility management board or municipality-owned company
concepts.authority_holder: Utility management board and designated security officer
concepts.distributor: Regional utility associations and incumbent industrial-control integrators
concepts.transaction_owner: Chief executive, technical director, or procurement lead
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid 30-day supplier-risk inventory with a prioritized remediation register
concepts.acquisition_route: Direct, account-based outreach to utilities paired with integrator referrals and procurement-ready fixed scopes
concepts.compounding_asset: Reusable control mappings and a benchmark dataset of recurring supplier risks across small utilities
hypotheses: Covered utilities lack staff to maintain supplier evidence continuously.
A narrow evidence operation can be procured below formal tender thresholds where lawful.
Applicability, procurement limits, and budgets must be verified per utility.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not claim to transfer statutory accountability from the utility or bypass public-procurement rules.

concepts.title: Cyber-Lifecycle File for Niche Device Importers
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Turn scattered manufacturer emails, vulnerability notices, software bills of materials, and patch commitments into a maintained product-lifecycle evidence file for small importers of connected devices.
concepts.customer: Polish importers and private-label sellers of connected industrial, wellness, and laboratory devices
concepts.loss_event: A product cannot be placed, retained, or defended in the EU market because its cyber documentation and vulnerability process are incomplete.
concepts.beneficiary: Compliance staff, distributors, and downstream buyers
concepts.authority_holder: Economic operator legally responsible for the product
concepts.distributor: Product-testing laboratories, customs advisers, and notified compliance specialists
concepts.transaction_owner: Managing director or head of product compliance
concepts.first_paid_event: Per-SKU evidence-gap review and supplier document request pack
concepts.acquisition_route: Referral partnerships with laboratories and customs advisers at the moment a shipment or listing is blocked
concepts.compounding_asset: Supplier-response benchmarks, device-category evidence templates, and recurring vulnerability-workflow integrations
hypotheses: Small importers will own meaningful documentation duties under the final applicable rules.
Testing firms prefer referring ongoing evidence maintenance rather than providing it.
Per-SKU budget and enforcement urgency are unknown.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not issue conformity declarations, legal opinions, or laboratory certifications without the required authority and competence.

concepts.title: Legacy Factory Remote-Access Custodian
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Operate a controlled approval, expiry, and evidence layer for third-party technicians accessing legacy machinery at small manufacturers.
concepts.customer: Small and midsize factories using vendor-maintained legacy production equipment
concepts.loss_event: Persistent or poorly documented vendor access enables compromise, production downtime, or rejection by a strategic customer.
concepts.beneficiary: Production team and customers requiring supply continuity
concepts.authority_holder: Factory owner and operational-technology system owner
concepts.distributor: Industrial maintenance firms, machinery integrators, and manufacturing insurers
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid mapping of all remote-access paths followed by one controlled vendor-access pilot
concepts.acquisition_route: Maintenance-partner channel and targeted outreach after customer security questionnaires expose evidence gaps
concepts.compounding_asset: A catalog of legacy-machine access patterns, vendor playbooks, and measurable remediation outcomes
hypotheses: Remote vendor access is both prevalent and insufficiently controlled in the target segment.
The service can coexist with machinery warranties and safety procedures.
Factories will pay for operational control rather than another advisory report.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not make unapproved changes to safety-critical machinery or create access that circumvents the equipment vendor.

concepts.title: Critical-Buyer Questionnaire Passport for Installers
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Maintain a reusable, evidence-linked cyber passport that lets renewable and building-automation installers answer recurring security questionnaires from utilities, banks, and critical-infrastructure buyers.
concepts.customer: Renewable-energy, electrical, and building-automation installers selling to regulated organizations
concepts.loss_event: A qualified installer loses or delays a contract because it cannot answer supplier-security questions or produce current evidence.
concepts.beneficiary: Installer sales team and regulated buyer's procurement team
concepts.authority_holder: Installer management and each buyer's procurement or security function
concepts.distributor: Equipment wholesalers, tender advisers, and sector associations
concepts.risk_bearer: Installer for lost revenue; buyer for supplier risk
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid conversion of one live buyer questionnaire into a reusable evidence passport
concepts.acquisition_route: Wholesaler referrals and direct outreach around live tenders with no camera-led audience building
concepts.compounding_asset: A normalized control-and-evidence graph across buyer questionnaires and installer toolchains
hypotheses: Questionnaire repetition is high enough to justify maintained evidence.
Buyers accept evidence-backed standardized answers.
Frequency of lost bids and actual subscription budget are unknown.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not fabricate controls, reuse confidential buyer questions without permission, or present the passport as an official certification.

concepts.title: Municipal Home-Care Proof Ledger
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Give municipalities and contracted care providers a low-friction ledger of assigned visits, exceptions, service notes, and quality follow-up that produces audit-ready evidence without recording unnecessary clinical detail.
concepts.customer: Municipal social-assistance centers and their outsourced home-care providers
concepts.loss_event: Missing or imprecise records conceal missed care, impede quality oversight, and create audit or payment disputes.
concepts.beneficiary: Care recipients, coordinators, and public funders
concepts.authority_holder: Municipal social-assistance director and contracted provider
concepts.distributor: Municipal associations, care-provider networks, and public-sector software resellers
concepts.transaction_owner: Social-assistance director or provider chief executive
concepts.first_paid_event: Eight-week paid pilot for one care team with missed-visit and documentation metrics
concepts.acquisition_route: Direct outreach using audit remediation language and reseller access to municipal procurement
concepts.compounding_asset: An anonymized taxonomy of service exceptions, documentation gaps, and remediation benchmarks
hypotheses: Existing municipal systems do not provide adequate field-level proof and quality follow-up.
Care workers can use the workflow without losing meaningful care time.
Procurement cycle and sustainable price are unknown.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not use continuous surveillance, collect excessive health data, or treat digital check-ins as proof of care quality by themselves.

concepts.title: Consent-Based Hidden-Senior Outreach Registry
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Help municipalities discover isolated seniors through permissioned referrals from pharmacies, housing managers, clinics, and community organizations, then route eligible people to human assessment.
concepts.customer: Municipalities that do not systematically identify seniors outside existing assistance registers
concepts.loss_event: A vulnerable resident remains unknown until a fall, health crisis, eviction, or caregiver collapse makes intervention more costly.
concepts.beneficiary: Isolated seniors, families, and local care systems
concepts.authority_holder: Municipality, referring institution, and the resident whose consent is required
concepts.distributor: Pharmacy groups, housing cooperatives, primary-care networks, and senior NGOs
concepts.risk_bearer: Municipality for service failure and resident for privacy or non-response risk
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid neighborhood pilot that tests referral consent, assessment completion, and successful service connections
concepts.acquisition_route: One anchor municipality plus local institutional partners, followed by a replicable inter-institution agreement pack
concepts.compounding_asset: A privacy-preserving referral protocol and locality-level service-capacity map
hypotheses: Trusted local institutions will invite rather than silently profile residents.
Municipalities have capacity to respond to newly identified needs.
Legal basis, consent design, and procurement budget require local validation.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: No covert health inference, data brokerage, or sharing of identifiable resident data without a valid legal basis and transparent consent where required.

concepts.title: Rural Care Shift Backstop Cooperative
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Coordinate a vetted reserve pool that contracted home-care providers can call when sickness or turnover would otherwise cancel an essential rural care visit.
concepts.customer: Home-care providers and municipalities in rural and mixed municipalities
concepts.loss_event: A caregiver absence produces an uncovered visit, interrupted service, family work loss, or unsafe time alone for a dependent senior.
concepts.beneficiary: Senior, family caregiver, and primary provider
concepts.authority_holder: Provider care coordinator and municipality under the service contract
concepts.distributor: Nursing schools, caregiver training organizations, municipalities, and provider associations
concepts.risk_bearer: Primary provider for contractual failure and cooperative for substitute quality
concepts.first_paid_event: Monthly availability retainer plus the first fulfilled emergency shift
concepts.acquisition_route: Cluster adjacent municipalities and providers around one regional reserve pool before expanding
concepts.compounding_asset: Verified worker availability, travel-time data, competency records, and demand forecasts by locality
hypotheses: Providers suffer enough costly uncovered shifts to fund standby capacity.
A dense-enough regional labor pool can meet response times.
Employment status, credentials, insurance, and unit economics remain unresolved.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not misclassify workers, suppress wages, send unqualified substitutes, or leave responsibility for care handoff ambiguous.

concepts.title: Care Handoff Reconciliation Desk
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Provide a human-in-the-loop reconciliation service that turns hospital discharge instructions, family notes, and municipal care plans into one confirmed task list with named owners and escalation points.
concepts.customer: Private home-care agencies, municipal care coordinators, and families of recently discharged seniors
concepts.loss_event: Conflicting instructions or an unowned task causes medication error, missed follow-up, readmission, or caregiver dispute.
concepts.payer: Home-care agency, municipality, or adult child
concepts.beneficiary: Senior and all formal and informal caregivers
concepts.authority_holder: Patient or lawful representative; clinicians retain authority over clinical decisions
concepts.distributor: Discharge coordinators, rehabilitation facilities, pharmacies, and care agencies
concepts.risk_bearer: Care provider and family, with clinicians responsible for clinical orders
concepts.transaction_owner: Care-agency coordinator or adult child arranging post-discharge care
concepts.first_paid_event: Fixed-fee 72-hour post-discharge reconciliation and confirmation call
concepts.acquisition_route: Referral agreements with rehabilitation facilities and home-care agencies at discharge
concepts.compounding_asset: A structured library of handoff failure modes, escalation rules, and provider-directory data
hypotheses: Families or providers will pay to reduce coordination risk immediately after discharge.
Consent-based access to required documents can be obtained quickly.
Clinical liability boundary and referral economics need validation.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not diagnose, change prescriptions, impersonate clinicians, or access health records without authorization.

concepts.title: Heat-Safe Home Retrofit for Aging in Place
concepts.one_sentence_thesis: Bundle a home assessment with small energy, ventilation, shade, backup-power, and remote-temperature interventions for seniors whose homes undermine safe independent living.
concepts.customer: Adult children, municipalities, housing cooperatives, and home-care providers supporting seniors at home
concepts.loss_event: Unsafe indoor heat, cold, power loss, or poor ventilation triggers illness, emergency relocation, or preventable caregiver escalation.
concepts.payer: Adult child, property owner, municipality, or targeted grant program
concepts.authority_holder: Property owner and resident, with licensed installers for regulated work
concepts.distributor: Home-care agencies, municipal senior programs, energy auditors, and renewable-installation firms
concepts.transaction_owner: Adult child or municipal care coordinator
concepts.first_paid_event: Paid safety-and-energy assessment credited toward a fixed-scope retrofit
concepts.acquisition_route: Regional pilots through care agencies and municipal programs, using installer capacity rather than consumer influencer marketing
concepts.compounding_asset: A dataset linking dwelling conditions, chosen interventions, energy performance, and care-related incident reports
hypotheses: Home-environment failures are a material contributor to interrupted independent living in the target region.
Payers value a care-oriented bundle more than separate contractor quotes.
Grant eligibility, measurable health impact, and willingness to pay are unknown.
concepts.prohibited_reliance: Must not make unsupported medical claims, pressure vulnerable residents, or perform regulated electrical work without proper authorization.
